dialogues.speaker: Citrouillard
dialogues.text: I—I'm fine! I j—just need to catch my breath... I'm a m—merchant. I'm not used to w—working out so hard...

dialogues.speaker: Citrouillard
dialogues.text: Phew, the training classes here are way more intense than I expected...

dialogues.speaker: Citrouillard
dialogues.text: I thought I was signing up for a standard weight loss class. You know, some basic aerobics, a lecture or two on good nutrition... I never thought it would be this vigorous!

dialogues.speaker: Citrouillard
dialogues.text: But I can't quit now — I've already pre-paid! I even bought a VIP membership... If only I'd known it would be this grueling, I'd have gone with my sister to the Masters of the Night-Wind...
